qualification.conditions: Own DS Table7-4 PDF47: VDD 1.7..5.5 V, VDDA=VDD, ambient -40..85 C with retained factory HSI. Actual HCLK/PCLK <=24 MHz below 1.8 V and <=96 MHz otherwise.
qualification.bypass_conflict: Own RM PDF55 qualifies 4..32 MHz; DS PDF54 gives 1..32 MHz. Admit only the actual 4..32 MHz intersection for both crystal and bypass.
qualification.parameters: Own HSE register PDF76 has no range selector. DRIVER and PDRIVER are four bits, but only 0..7 documented; use the same board-selected drive for both. WAITCYCLE=3, DIGFLT=false; no parameter changes after enable. Preserve HEXENPOL and RFU. DIGFLT=true and automatic HEXEN control are deferred.
qualification.security: Own RM PDF62/PDF71 forces nominal HSI4 MHz after CLKCCS fallback, independent of requested HSI DIV. This is /24 of factory 96 MHz, not the HAL default /12=8 MHz. Preserve CLKCCS/HSECCS/LSECCS/LSELOCK and unchanged legal LSI, including automatic requests. Relevant sticky HSE/LSE FAIL/FAULT are rejected without clearing.
qualification.pins: Own DS PDF35 establishes PF0 OSC_IN physical5 and PF1 OSC_OUT physical6 for both LQFP48 and QFN48; wrong RM PDF67 example PB7/PC13 is not used. No ADC/VC/OPA overlap on these pads. GPIO lacks LOCK/SPEED/HIGHIE/LOWIE; only PF3 has PDR, so never write PF0/PF1 PDR. Preserve ODR/shared filter/interrupt flags.
qualification.entry: Undeclared enabled HSE is refused before MMIO writes. Any declared enabled HSE requires exact mode/drive/wait/filter/detector/pad reuse and is never stopped or rewritten, including RTC/AWT owners. Fresh HSE requires HSEEN=0 and STABLE=0. RTC source3 requires enabled stable factory HSI and blocks retrim; PSC1-derived RTCCLKD also feeds AWT and must stay <=1 MHz even with calendar START=0.
qualification.analog: Inspect both ADC1/ADC2 EN; all VC1..4 PCLK filtering and all32 CR2 blanking enables; OPA1/2 CALEN/AZRUN/START; both DAC channels trigger/DMA/wave state. Reject timing-dependent retained activity before clock mutation. Inspect LVD directly: no own RCC gate. Preserve static analog owners, BGR/TS/references and configuration gates without resets.
qualification.ownership: Capture common inherited LSE reservation before backend writes. HSE reservations union inherited and requested mode for the boot; exact reuse cannot release any pad. Source loss never releases GPIO ownership.
qualification.contract: One-time direct HSI/HSE initialization; no PLL, LSE setup, runtime retune, sleep/resume or recovery. Actual incoming source/buses/Flash and unchanged LSI must already be legal. Finite polls require CPU progress; STABLE is startup-only. Frozen external timings cease to apply after source loss/fallback; failed init requires reset.
qualification.transition: Raise and acknowledge Flash WAIT3 first; enable and poll unchanged HSI; write guarded prescalers plus explicit HSI selector together in keyed CR0, then verify selector/dividers/HSIEN/STABLE and faults. Incoming HSI TRIM must already yield legal90..100MHz whenever enabled, including when initially disabled. This avoids stale external-selector replay; it is not source-loss recovery.

reviewed_transition_correction.change: Enable/poll unchanged HSI after acknowledged Flash WAIT3, then one keyed CR0 write explicitly selects HSI and guarded dividers; poll selector/dividers/enabled/stable/faults and barrier.
reviewed_transition_correction.preconditions: Legal stable incoming clocks/buses/Flash and legal unchanged HSIOSC whenever enabled, including initially disabled HSI. No arbitrary TRIM or source-loss recovery guarantee.
